concepts.goal: Scaled dot-product attention: multiply Q by K transpose to get the scores, then divide by the square root of d_k. Work a small numeric example.
Softmax over the attention scores: turn one row of scores into weights that sum to one, then use them to mix the rows of V.
Multi-head attention: several heads attend in parallel with their own projections, then their outputs are concatenated and projected.

papers.title: Newton's Method in Three Precisions (Kelley, arXiv 2307.16051)

concepts.goal: The Newton iteration x+ = xc - F'(xc)^-1 F(xc): solve the Jacobian system for the step, then update. Work one step on a small 2x2 system.
Iterative refinement: solve with a cheap low-precision factorization, compute the residual in higher precision, and correct, repeating until the residual is small.
Why three precisions: residual in double, Jacobian stored in single, factorization in half, because the O(N^3) factorization dominates the cost.
